evidence.text: Use Pin bordism to motivate defects and compactify on inversion quotients. For 9d, project the massless spectrum on T³/Z₂ and impose the 6d gravitational condition 273 = 29nT + nH − nV. For 8d, compute the reduced 5d parity anomaly using η invariants and Ω₆^Pin− = Z₁₆.
